title: Multimodal Support in Gen AI Studio Playground
assumptions: The Strategy and final Staff Engineer clarifications override the broader original RFE wishlist.
The proposed 10 MB image/audio limit is used for demonstration; PM confirmation is pending.
Model labels and modality combinations are illustrative, not certified catalog data.
Persona catalog and overlays were not staged; model-explorer is inferred from Playground experimentation tasks.
ASR capability is represented as an endpoint checkbox; this is an open design question in the source.
Assets persist in sessionStorage for cross-page mock registration. Chat history is in memory only.
Backend uploads, temporary storage, base64 encoding, OGX routing, authentication, transcription, inference, and timing are simulated. No network model calls are made.
The local sample WAV is a silent audio fixture used only to demonstrate playback controls; transcription text is mocked.
Eight Playground scenarios cover primary visible states. MIME, size, zero-byte, second-file, unknown-capability, and vision-only branches are exercised interactively.
No microphone, PDF image input, generated audio playback, streaming, model comparison, or chat persistence is implemented.
